findings.title: Stale SSE protocol doc for error event
findings.desc: The JSDoc above `streamLlm` still documents `event: error — { error: "message", details: "..." }`, but the diff removed `details` from the emitted error payload (`sseEvent("error", { error: message })`). The doc is now misleading for anyone implementing an SSE consumer.

findings.title: `details` silently dropped from client-facing error SSE event
findings.desc: Previously the `error` SSE event forwarded `details` (echoing provider error bodies) to the client; this diff removes it entirely from the outgoing event, not just from logs. Any existing frontend code reading `data.details` from the `error` SSE event will silently lose that information, and this is inconsistent with `app/api/edit/artifact/route.ts`, which still returns a `details` field to the (self-originating) caller for the same class of error.
